statement: The record lists sector 7 as “open” but also gives ban hours of 12:00–23:00; because sector 7 is closed today under the stadium-event flight ban, I will hold job SV-19.
judge_text:
WRONG
It flags the contradiction—"lists sector 7 as 'open' but... sector 7 is closed today under the stadium-event flight ban"—and holds the job.
